newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON KEY CURRENCIES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON KEY CURRENCIES.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Monday's session firmer on the U.S. dollar on the back of some foreign currency inflows and on central bank support but it softened on key European units as it tracked their movements overseas.
"I don't think there were any major payments made today but there were some receipts coming in and the dollar strengthened on the U.S. dollar," one dealer said.
"The Reserve Bank was also in the market but not in a big way to support the dollar around the 11.2875 level," he added.
The local unit closed at 11.2750/2850 on the U.S. dollar from 11.2825/2925 at Friday's close and also firmed marginally to 2.5425/5460 on the rand versus 2.5470/5490.
On the crosses, it weakened to 18.1440/1670 on sterling from 18.0520/0620 and to 6.6690/6770 compared to 6.6660/6680.
